profile.headline: Software Engineering Leader - Medical Device and Lifesciences | SAFe® 6 Architect | SAFe® 5 Product Manager | CSM | MCTS | AZ-900 | DICOM Certified
profile.jobTitle: Senior Manager – IoT Product Engineering Projects
profile.summary:
Strategic and transformational Software Leader with 12+ years of experience leading global engineering teams in healthcare, life science and education domains. Proven track record in architecting and delivering enterprise-scale solutions using cloud-native technologies and microservices architecture. Demonstrated success in building high-performing teams, fostering innovation, and ensuring regulatory compliance in medical device software development.

• Successful track record of building and leading software engineering teams of 20+ Engineer. Proficient in talent acquisition, mentoring, and creating a positive and collaborative team culture. 

• Extensive experience overseeing the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment. Skilled delivering high-quality software within tight deadlines.

• Adept at fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the engineering team. Proven ability to introduce new technologies and methodologies to enhance development processes.

• Proficient in aligning software development efforts with business objectives. Skilled in strategic planning, resource allocation, and adapting to evolving market needs.

positions.title: Senior Manager – IoT Product Engineering Projects
positions.description:
- Directed software delivery for strategic medical device programs, leading 4 Scrum teams (28+ engineers) to improve delivery predictability, shorten decision cycles, and enhance execution across high-value client initiatives.
- Owned integration delivery for Radiation Therapy devices, improving interoperability for mission-critical clinical workflows and reducing delivery risk in a highly regulated environment.
- Lead modernization of a 240+ project legacy medical device platform, enabling scalable architecture and hybrid cloud/on-prem deployment.
- Initiated and led the A3C Committee to scale enterprise adoption of Claude AI through standardized developer guidance, token efficiency practices, context engineering, MCP integrations, and responsible AI governance.
positions.insights: Claude Code, Context Engineering and +4 skills

positions.title: Senior Manager - Lead Product Software Engineer
positions.description:
I played a pivotal role in leading product software engineering initiatives that significantly impacted client satisfaction and revenue growth.  
• Drove collaboration across global teams, increasing delivery efficiency and team engagement by 30%.  
• Designed a microservice-based framework, improving deployment flexibility and reducing bug rates by 15%.  
• Fostered a culture of continuous improvement through talent development and performance management across four Scrum teams.
positions.insights: Microservice Architecture, Azure Containerization (Kubernetes), Healthcare and Educational Domain  and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Manager - Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led and managed 4 Scrum teams comprising 28 Software Engineers to deliver innovative enterprise healthcare applications.  
• Served as Technical Project Manager, defining scope and priorities for critical healthcare systems, ensuring timely delivery.  
• Designed the Framework 40 Library, a customized SOA framework, enhancing application architecture and compliance.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
I successfully managed cross-team communications and developed critical software solutions in the healthcare sector.  
• Led the development of the User Interface for the CP150 monitoring device, enhancing user experience.  
• Designed a DICOM Toolkit that streamlined ECG data communication, improving interoperability.  
• Facilitated training workshops that significantly boosted team proficiency in DICOM standards.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented Dash Mobile System (Inventor y Management System) for Window Mobile using Agile Methodology. 
o	Technology used: C#.Net (.Net 3.5 Framework, Window Mobile 6.0/7.0, Web Service, MVP Pattern
•	Implemented FLOQR (User Tracking System) platform for IPhone Device. Platforms provide the Push Notification and Alerting services for IPhone Device and Web base solution to track the user. 
o	Technology Used: C#, ASP.net, WCF Rest Service, MVC 2.0, LinQ, MS Chart.
positions.insights: Healthcare and Educational Domain , C#, .Net Frameworks, Angular JS, MVC, MVP, MVVM Patterns, WCF, SSIS, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained the Pocket Courier\Draw application for Pocket PC, enhancing efficiency for couriers and technicians.  
• Created a Data Migration utility using C#.Net and SSIS, successfully transferring data from LIS to HIS.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design scalable software solutions, actively participating in Agile ceremonies.  
• Conducted code reviews and ensured verification and validation of deliverables, contributing to high-quality software development.
